name: tokenshield
description: Universal AI token & cost optimizer for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Antigravity. Real-time context pruning, AST skeletons, semantic caching, CLI output compression, and provable ROI reporting.

commands.title: TokenShield: Compress & Copy Pruned Context to Clipboard
TokenShield: Show Live Per-Chat Savings Breakdown
TokenShield: Reset Session Savings / Start New Session
TokenShield: Compress & Copy Git Diff Context (CAP-11)
TokenShield: Initialize for This Project (Stack-Specific Instructions)

aiTokenOptimizer.enabled.description: Enable or disable all token optimizations.

aiTokenOptimizer.autoApply.description: Automatically apply token optimization directives when opening a workspace.

aiTokenOptimizer.targetTools.description: Which AI tools to generate instruction files for.

aiTokenOptimizer.profile.description: Active optimization profile. Profiles control which strategies are enabled.
enumDescriptions: All 19 strategies active — maximum enterprise token & cost savings
Disables output compression and diff-only for full log & test diagnostics
Disables verbosity restrictions and guardrails for deep architectural reviews
Preserves full context history for thorough code reviews
Use custom strategy combination from activeStrategies setting

outputCompression.description: CAP-2: RTK output compression for CLI & test commands

semanticCache.description: CAP-5: Local semantic cache (zero model tokens for repeated questions)

astSkeleton.description: CAP-6: AST structural skeleton extraction (~90% context reduction)

contextExclusion.description: CAP-7: Smart context exclusion (auto-exclude lock files, dist/, minified code)

diffOnlyOutput.description: CAP-8: Diff-only output format (~92% output token savings)

agentGuardrails.description: CAP-9: Agent loop guardrails (prevents expensive runaway retry cycles)

smartModelRouting.description: CAP-10: Smart model routing (suggests lighter models for routine edits)

gitDiffContext.description: CAP-11: Git diff-scoped context (scope reviews to git diff + 1-hop callers/callees)

kvCacheAlignment.description: CAP-12: Deterministic prefix caching — for API/agent-mode workflows, not VS Code Copilot chat

commentStripper.description: CAP-13: Comment & header stripping — strip license preambles and filler comments on ingestion

testFailureIsolator.description: CAP-14: Test log failure isolation — filter to failing assertions and line numbers only

rangeSlicing.description: CAP-15: Windowed range slicing — restrict file navigation to 100-line windows around symbols

inlineChatScopePinning.description: CAP-16: Inline chat scope pinning — constrain VS Code inline chat context to selected lines + 1-hop references

copilotIgnoreGeneration.description: CAP-17: .copilotignore generation — create .copilotignore to block build outputs, lock files, and secrets from Copilot context

copilotEditsAwareness.description: CAP-18: Copilot Edits awareness — avoid re-reading files already open in a Copilot Edits session

threadResetTrigger.description: CAP-19: Thread reset trigger — surface a fresh-thread nudge when conversation exceeds 40 messages

aiTokenOptimizer.activeStrategies.description: Toggle individual strategies (used when profile is 'custom').

aiTokenOptimizer.verbosityLevel.description: Verbosity reduction level: Light (~20%), Full (~35%), Ultra (~50%).

aiTokenOptimizer.preserveExistingInstruc.description: Preserve existing user content in instruction files when updating.

aiTokenOptimizer.autoInstallTools.description: Automatically check and install supporting CLI tools.

aiTokenOptimizer.configureMcpOnActivatio.description: Automatically configure MCP servers (token-cache, Context7, CodeGraph) on activation.

aiTokenOptimizer.pricing.description: Model pricing table in USD per 1M tokens (used for ROI dashboard calculations).

maxRetries.description: CAP-9: Max retry attempts before pausing for user input

maxFilesPerTask.description: CAP-9: Max files to modify in one task before asking confirmation

maxFileReads.description: CAP-9: Max reads of the same file in a single conversation

aiTokenOptimizer.useVscodeStorage.description: Store instructions cleanly in .vscode/copilot-instructions.md instead of modifying public git tracking. Use 'Export to Repository' command when team-wide repo commit is desired.

aiTokenOptimizer.githubInstructions.description: Write instructions to .github/ (the path VS Code Copilot auto-discovers). Recommended: true. Set false only if you prefer to keep all generated files out of git.

aiTokenOptimizer.githubStructureMode.description: How TokenShield integrates with .github/: 'auto' detects structured layout (.github/instructions/), 'flat' writes directly to .github/copilot-instructions.md, 'structured' writes to .github/instructions/tokenshield.instructions.md.

aiTokenOptimizer.generateAgentFiles.description: Scaffold TokenShield agent (.github/agents/tokenshield.agent.md) and optimization skill (.github/skills/tokenshield-optimize/SKILL.md) in structured .github repositories.

aiTokenOptimizer.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable 100% on-device ROI and token savings tracking.
